commands.name: list.add
commands.description: Add items to a list in the Notes app, e.g. "add milk and eggs to my shopping list". Creates the list if it is new.

things.description: The things to add, separated by commas or "and"

commands.name: list.read
commands.description: Read a list from the Notes app, e.g. "what is on my shopping list".

commands.name: note.create
commands.description: Write a new note in the Notes app, e.g. "make a note that the plumber comes on Tuesday".
